hearth.name: The Hearth
hearth.description: The fire has burned low, but it has not gone out. Velvet-dark walls keep the room close without making it small.
hearth.lookText: A low fire, two deep cushions, and one open doorway. Nothing here is asking you to become anything.
hearth.sitText: You settle beside the fire. Nothing rewards you. Nothing interrupts you. The room remains.

gallery.name: The Gallery of Unfinished Things
gallery.description: Frames line the walls with more patience than purpose. Some are empty. Some seem to be waiting for an image that has not happened yet.
gallery.lookText: The Hearth waits west. A quieter passage continues north. One blue flower rests beneath an empty frame.
gallery.sitText: You sit beneath the unfinished frames. They do not hurry to become complete.

threshold.name: The Threshold
threshold.description: A tall mirror occupies the northern wall. It reflects the room exactly, except for a darkness where another doorway might someday be. To the east, the architecture thins into an unwritten edge.
threshold.lookText: South returns to the Gallery. North is presently a mirror and nothing more. East is not a doorway so much as the possibility of one.
threshold.sitText: You sit before the mirror. Your reflection is under no obligation to explain itself.
